title: Kun Chen YOLO-agent ops: disposable Nix machine plus gated secrets
summary: Kun Chen explains running coding agents with all permission checks off by treating the laptop as a disposable employee device, rebuilding from nix-darwin dotfiles, and routing secrets through AutomicVault human approval gates.
question_it_answers: How can you safely run agents with permission checks disabled on a local machine?

claims.text: Author disables all agent permission checks and skips auto-review, treating the machine as an employee laptop not a personal device.
claims.evidence: i always disable all permission checks for my agents - i don't even do auto review.
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops

claims.text: Recovery path is nix-darwin plus home-manager dotfiles: wipe, clone, rebuild in minutes.
claims.evidence: i use nix-darwin and home-manager to make my entire machine instantly reproducible.
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops

claims.text: Production secrets stay off disk; AutomicVault gates each secret access while agents run commands freely.
claims.evidence: every time my agents need to access a secret, they go through me and i can decide whether i allow it or not
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops
